semanticAuthorization.basis: Frozen ASYNC001 selects database-backed, fixed UTC/coalesced singleton scheduling and finite budgets, and assigns compiler declarations to RM306. The milestone recognises this existing pressure syntax while withholding execution.

The preserved pressure source already spells job overdue_reminders every 15m with concurrency: singleton, run: send_due_reminders(clock.now), retry: next_schedule. NAME-D02 places jobs in lower_snake_case.

Current grammar section16 describes first-slice jobs as unsupported until specification and fixtures; it is an implementation boundary, not a permanent prohibition or a new owner-decision requirement. The saved reviewed narrow plan can govern the next frontend slice. It does not imply a job production already exists in current implemented grammar.
The owning delivery plan assigns exact checked parser spelling/canonical job fixtures to RM306 after the semantic freeze. Its staging preserves remaining event acceptance rather than waiving it.

RM222/RM309 successor event/subscriber/component grammar remains separate and conditional. This milestone adds none of those constructs and does not change current auth/principal/query syntax or adopt successor effect ownership.

sourceAssessments.assessment: There is currently no Declaration::Job. DurationLiteral and InvocationExpression are typed reusable AST pieces; RouteDeclaration supplies a recovery-friendly optional run precedent. A Job variant must participate in range/exhaustive visitors without becoming a callable or public export.

Current declaration dispatch has no job branch. Route run accepts InvocationExpression; job parsing can reuse that representation but must separately enforce one valid occurrence of every clause and reject unknown clauses. Duration parsing must require duration kind, then validate positive finite representable milliseconds; copying a text reader alone would accept non-duration forms.

Dedicated job checking is necessary: the current route branch installs clock only for inline actions. Job run must get the intrinsic clock.now: Instant environment and resolve its callee to an action with exactly one nonnullable builtin Instant parameter and builtin Unit result. Raw text/suffix matches and representation-equivalent impostor types do not satisfy resolved identity.

Current prelude includes Unit/Instant; graph distinguishes callable kinds and diagnoses non-callable uses. Add job entry/call evidence without placing jobs in the ordinary callable set or granting service authority. The pressure app's other unsupported declarations or None return spelling are not newly certified by accepting its job block.

Reuse checked callable failure/effect evidence, not route HTTP-failure mapping. Derive the job's reachable failures/effects and explicitly label unqualified durable dispositions as pending/rejected for execution; next_schedule is neither retry budget nor uncertainty handling.

Target currently collects ordinary declarations/callables and emits private operation context. It must reject any newly parsed job before artifact generation while checked worker lowering/profile support is absent. Do not ignore a job, emit an inert registry/no-op, call its action once at startup, or use target suffix fallback as the semantic run resolver.

milestoneAcceptance: Typed Declaration::Job and source spans; preserve the exact pressure job block. Require exactly one concurrency: singleton, run invocation, and retry: next_schedule; reject missing, duplicate, malformed and unknown clauses without silently retaining a replacement valid value.
Require a positive finite supported duration literal; reject bare numbers, strings, zero/negative/nonrepresentable values, unsupported units and cron/concurrency modes outside this slice.

Run callee resolves through existing module/import/entity rules to an action, not a job/query/function/service operation/unknown or ambiguous symbol. Exactly one positional argument must be the intrinsic clock.now; reject extra/named/principal inputs, nested calls and other expressions. Require exactly one nonnullable builtin Instant parameter and builtin Unit result.

Jobs are non-callable and non-exported. Validate lower_snake_case naming and duplicate identities under existing namespace/resolution rules. Do not introduce a broad source-level registration or host capability.
Dedicated job clock typing; compiler-derived resolved call/failure/effect evidence. No authored UUID/version/fence/receipt/outcome/principal properties, new role grant or bypass.

Static analysis/checking can succeed for the narrow declaration even while runtime execution dispositions remain unavailable. Build/target must return an explicit unsupported-job/lowering diagnostic until the required finite profile and checked worker exist; no generated output may silently omit or execute the job.

Positive/negative parser/type fixtures, canonical formatter handling, audit/effect evidence and fail-closed target regression are required for milestone verification. Existing source without jobs must retain its behavior. This plan review has not executed those future checks.
routineTechnicalOptions: Rust field/enum names, parser recovery representation, diagnostic identifiers and canonical clause formatting are implementation choices within the closed reviewed semantics.
Use existing keyword/resolution conventions; contextual parser dispatch is not permission to relax naming or reserved-identifier rules.

Graph/descriptor representation for a scheduled runtime entry is routine so long as jobs remain non-callable, resolved action/effects are explicit and no false scheduler/authority evidence is emitted.
Parser/type fixtures can use a minimal action taking Instant and returning Unit. They need not compile the entire preserved golden pressure application or invent a None alias.

Finite profile values, auth/worker binding and failure dispositions need not be guessed to implement a non-executing frontend milestone. They remain real execution gates, not blockers to this parser/type milestone.
retainedExecutionGates: Reviewed finite execution/lease and cumulative invocation/lifetime profile, compatible with frozen ASYNC001 and applicable RM108/SERVICE001 limits; no universal numeric defaults.

Checked worker/service authentication and live current policy admission, secret handoff and independently reviewed grants. The human reports an approved self-disable repair in parallel; this review neither reapproves that repair nor infers reminder authority from it.

Explicit CheckedReminderDeliveryBinding and bounded scan/selection/admission plan: source revision hooks on create/successful supplied due_at patch, immutable closed payload, handler/version/order key and revision-guarded completion. No inference from an action name or rewriting ordinary service calls into enqueue.

Separate scheduled activation, Todo schedule revision and delivery claim/fence. No scan/restart budget reset, no provider call inside authority transaction, and no blind replay after possible effects.
Applicable implementation review plus real generated worker/scheduler tests and frozen ASYNC traces on both adapters. No direct action call or private storage suite substitutes.
RM306 event acceptance and conditional RM309/RM310/RM311 successor gates remain open; no generic events, subscribers, transition publication, fan-out, ownership graph or joins adopted.

verification.mode: Independent static source/spec and saved-plan review only; pre-implementation milestone.
verification.limits: No runtime safety, scheduler conformance, policy qualification, all golden behavior or future parser implementation is certified. Main's parallel gate/policy work and existing private retry tests were not polled or treated as proof of this milestone.
